credit.title: The Repayment-Strain Transmission Test
credit.question: Do mortgage rates add forward information about reported payment problems beyond persistence?
credit.limits: Annual survey percentages are not arrears balances, PD or bank losses. Small latest-vintage sample; survey and rate revisions are not archived in real time. The regression is exploratory and its forecast origins are not independent.

financial.title: The Power-Diversification Stress Test
financial.question: Can frozen cross-zone weights reduce held-out Norwegian power-price volatility?
financial.limits: The workbook has 8,760 indexed observations but clock time, time zone and DST alignment remain NOT VERIFIED. Price-index volatility is not investment return, dispatch profit or an executable hedge. Long-only weights use a stated ridge and were selected after inspecting this dataset.

accounting.title: The Capital-Intensity Memory Test
accounting.question: Is a three-year median more reliable than the last reported capex-intensity ratio?
accounting.limits: The ratio uses cash capex and CFO, not total economic investment. CFO includes working-capital effects; cash capex excludes some leases and noncash additions. Six issuers and issuer-cluster resampling cannot establish a universal forecasting law. Fiscal years differ.

business.title: The AI Consideration–Deployment Gap
business.question: How far apart are reported AI consideration and current use within the same geography and size class?
business.limits: Separate survey indicators are compared within identical geography, year and size class. This is not a firm-level funnel: respondents and questionnaire routing may differ, and 'ever considered' is not assumed to contain every current user. Repeated cross-sections; no sampling errors or microdata were supplied, so inferential confidence intervals are NOT VERIFIED.

public_finance.title: The Fiscal-Balance Forecasting Trap
public_finance.question: Does a component-based rule beat simple persistence for next-year net lending?
public_finance.limits: Nominal consolidated general-government flows, 1995–2024. This is not the structural non-oil budget balance, fiscal-rule headroom or a sovereign-credit model. The component rule is exploratory and latest-vintage; petroleum prices, inflation and revisions are not modelled. Variance contributions are accounting covariance shares, not causal effects.
